title: /help <question> is consumed by the composer and answered by tracy-web without the agent; Help conversations are per agent session; Help reads only chosen facts and cannot change a site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://tracy:tracy@127.0.0.1:51730/postgres node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/assistant.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/assistant-readers.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/help.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/report.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/chat.test.mjs (any Postgres whose user may create schemas will do).

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "Help: one conversation per agent session"; "Help: a malformed session id falls back"; "Help: the one-time tip"; "Help prompt: Discord is the one outside link"; "Help prompt: the agent session is two facts"; "a question posts the text, the session and the anchor seq"; "a second question waits for the first"; "only 3 questions may wait"; "Stop keeps what arrived"; "a 429 on the day window"; "no call ever leaves for anything but /api/assistant"; "Help: an answer can be rated by its own account only"; "the readers import nothing of sites/ or seats/ and call no door"; "a failing database reads as unavailable"; "recentActivity gives times and the end reason, never the turn title or reply"; "the prompt carries the site on screen"; "an editor’s prompt lists teammates without emails"; "without a site on screen no per-site reader runs"; "a reader that cannot read leaves a "cannot see" line"; "Help prompt: no invented policies"; "asking to report a problem puts a report on the row"; "the report holds the chosen fields and the person’s words"; "rating: the answer id comes from done"; "after a 429 the queue is held, and the next question the person types lifts the hold and is sent".

S3: From vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness (submodule initialised, CI=true pnpm install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile done) run: npx vitest run packages/client/ui-commands packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-scenarios.client.spec.tsx packages/client/ui-chat. Record the 'Test Files' and 'Tests' lines.

S4 (stand, by hand or with tasks/bang-chung/stand/stand-scenario.mjs): dsh profile native from this checkout (node scripts/materialize-profile.mjs native; build vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar with npx tsdown; DSH_HOME=tch ./node_modules/.bin/dsh --profile native --no-open --port 51730). In the browser: type '/' (menu), '/help what is Site changes?' + Enter, '/HELP Xin Chào', bare '/help', press a chip, press thumbs up, send '/help first' and '/help second' quickly, then the order a person works in: send 'make the footer phone 0909', then '/help how do I undo?', then 'also make it shorter'. Record every POST the page makes (assistant doors and the agent's POST /api/session/prompt) and the order of the three texts in the transcript.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests': the database cases ran, none skipped.

Every named case in S2 is 'ok': a turn sent with session.id 'sess-1' and 'sess-2' lands in two different conversations, each turn keeps its anchorSeq (a fractional 12.5 survives) and a restore with ?session= reads that session only; a session id that is not a plain token falls back to the account-level conversation and a non-numeric anchorSeq is stored as null; the tip is recorded once per account and read back as tipSeen; the prompt carries the Discord link and no Talk-to-a-person handoff and tells the model to pass nothing on to the agent; the controller sends exactly one POST /api/assistant/turns at a time, refuses a fourth waiting question on screen, keeps a stopped answer, pauses on a 429 with the 'day' window, and every request it makes goes to /api/assistant/*. Ratings: an answer is rated by its own account only (another account's answer, a question, a cleared conversation read as 404; a value other than 1, -1 or null is 400) and the thumb is put back when the server refuses. Readers: only chosen columns reach the prompt (no turn title or reply, notification or comment text), an editor never sees teammates' emails, per-site readers do not run without a site on screen, and a failed read becomes a 'not available right now' line. A request to report a problem adds a report built from site, time, session id, browser and the person's own words, with no email or conversation. After a 429 (minute or day) the next question the person types is SENT, not left on Waiting; the start screen's Help dock follows the newest row.

S3 passes with no failed file: an argued line '/x hello' for a takesText action is consumed whole and run receives 'hello' (no command.execute, no submit); the line guard clears the draft only while it equals the line; attachments refuse the line and keep the draft; caseInsensitive folds '/X Hello' to the lowercase command and keeps the text; a client-local row sits after every log row at or below its anchorSeq and above later agent rows, and with no local rows the transcript is identical to before.

S4: no floating AI Assistant button or Need help? pill; the '/' menu lists 'Ask about Tracy and your sites'; '/help <q>' empties the composer, sends exactly one POST /api/assistant/turns with message '<q>' and the session id and anchorSeq, and the answer and the question are drawn (in the dock on a blank session, in the transcript afterwards); '/HELP' folds to '/help'; a bare '/help' draws one greeting with four chips and sends nothing; two quick questions are sent one after the other with 'Waiting' shown; a thumbs up posts rating 1 to the answer id; an ordinary message sends nothing to /api/assistant and reaches the agent; in 'modify, /help, modify' the agent receives exactly the two modify messages and nothing of /help, and the transcript order is modify, Help, modify; no horizontal overflow at 375px. Captured in tasks/bang-chung/stand/ (26 checks).
evidence: PR #966 (tasks/todo-lenh-help.md): the floating AI Assistant button is replaced by /help in the agent's chat; the barrier is that the agent never receives the line, and that Help has no tools and no door that writes a site. Stand run 07/10/2026: tasks/bang-chung/stand/README.md.
fence: Mechanism only: the composer claims the line, the controller talks to /api/assistant only, the server keys conversations by (account, session) and the model gets no tools. Not covered here: the live dsh page on a stand (menu row, stream while the agent runs, reload placement, 375px, Electron) and the content of any answer; those are the stand levels of tasks/todo-lenh-help.md §9.
